app.title: Loan management
app.description: Loans, repayments, collateral and accounts for staff.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved. Nothing has been changed.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page could not be shown. Nothing has been saved. Try again, and if it happens again tell your manager the time it happened.
error.inAppTitle: This page could not be shown

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: For staff only. Accounts are created by the administrator.

errors.invalidInput: Enter your email address and password.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.
errors.inactive: This account is not active. Ask the administrator to check it.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a minute.

notices.inactive: This account is not active. Ask the administrator to check it.
notices.expired: For security, sessions end after 12 hours. Sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.forbidden: You do not have access to that page. You have been brought back to the dashboard.
dashboard.comingUp: Your work summary appears here as each part of the system is switched on: due loans, collections, approvals and cash.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve a request you made yourself.
errors.OVERPAYMENT: The amount is more than what is owed.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: There is not enough money in that account.
errors.REMITTANCE_MISMATCH: The counted total does not match the selected collections.
errors.DATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only today's date can be used.
errors.JOURNAL_UNBALANCED: Debits and credits do not balance.
errors.PERIOD_LOCKED: That day is closed. Ask a manager to reopen it first.
errors.COLLATERAL_REQUIRED: Add collateral before paying out this loan.
errors.COLLATERAL_ALREADY_PLEDGED: This item already secures another active loan.
errors.DUPLICATE_CUSTOMER: A customer with this phone or ID number already exists.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This cannot be done in the current state. Refresh the page and check the details.
errors.IMMUTABLE_RECORD: Saved records cannot be changed. Use a correction instead.
errors.INVALID_SETTING: One of the values is not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.DUPLICATE_EMAIL: A user with this email already exists.
errors.UPLOAD_REJECTED: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image of 10 MB or less.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pendingHint: Leave empty until MSI confirms it. Empty fields print blank on documents.

validation.amount: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 2,000.00.
validation.code: Use 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter, for example BR4.
validation.branchRequired: Cashiers and loan officers need a branch.

company.heading: Company header
company.intro: Shown on every screen, receipt and document.
company.name: Company name
company.logoIntro: Always shown on a white tile. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
company.templatesIntro: Placeholders in braces are filled in for each loan: {placeholders}.
company.reminder: Reminder before or on the due date

branches.heading: Branches
branches.intro: The branch code appears in loan, receipt and expense numbers and cannot change later.
branches.name: Name
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add the first branch to start.

rules.heading: Rule settings
rules.intro: Defaults from the assumption register. Each value is waiting for MSI sign-off (see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md).
rules.loanManagerLimit: Largest loan a manager may approve (A-07)
rules.loanManagerLimitHelp: Above this amount the CEO must approve.
rules.expenseLimit: Expenses recorded without manager approval, up to (A-20)
rules.collateralRequired: Collateral is required for every loan (A-10)
rules.multiLoan: One collateral item may secure more than one active loan (A-10)
rules.requireRemittance: Field collections must be handed over to a cashier (A-12)
rules.checkFunds: Check the cash balance before paying out a loan
rules.allocationIntro: Each payment pays these parts in this order.
rules.goLiveHelp: Before this date the accountant and admin may enter back-dated records. Leave empty until it is agreed.
rules.clockIntro: Moves the system date for demonstrations. Production always uses the real date.
rules.clockFrozen: Keep the clock stopped at this time

users.heading: Users
users.intro: Only the administrator creates accounts. Staff cannot sign themselves up.
users.name: Full name
users.resetConfirm: Reset the password for {name}? Their current password stops working at once.
users.passwordIntro: Give this password to {name} in person. It is shown only once and is not stored anywhere you can see it again.
users.selfNote: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change in the system, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.
